evals.prompt: Migrate a v3 workspace when the member origin chain ends at a local repository, while the registry declares a network remote.
evals.expected_output: Loads all applicable migration rules in full, treats the registry remote as locator authority, produces a dry-run proposal with the network canonical remote, and does not edit the registry or any external Git config directly.

evals.prompt: Migrate a v3 workspace when the live network remote and registry network remote conflict.
evals.expected_output: Stops with a typed canonical-remote conflict, asks the user which remote is authoritative, and reruns with the explicit dispatcher remote override only after the user decides; it does not choose silently.

evals.prompt: Run doctor-project --repair --force on an already migrated metadata-version-4 workspace.
evals.expected_output: Routes to v4 control-plane validation and repair, preserves portable project.yaml bytes, and never rewrites the workspace back to v3 shape.

evals.prompt: Initialize a new ordinary v3 single-repository workspace whose origin is already unambiguous.
evals.expected_output: Uses the ordinary init-project lifecycle, creates or preserves script/index.yaml and credentials/credentials.yaml with protected permissions, and does not invoke v4 migration remote override or control-plane publication behavior.

evals.prompt: Initialize or attach a portable v4 single-repository workspace whose source Git repository is the workspace root.
evals.expected_output: Creates or preserves the workspace script and credential resources, excludes .work-bundle/ and credentials/ from the source Git repository without replacing existing exclusions, keeps portable metadata free of local paths, and does not classify those resources as topology drift.

evals.prompt: Publish an existing clean control-plane repository when the commit succeeds but the remote rejects the push.
evals.expected_output: Restores the exact pre-operation HEAD, metadata bytes, origin configuration, clean worktree and index, leaves no rollback residue, and persists redacted transaction evidence; a dirty or otherwise unsafe pre-state fails closed with a typed recovery-required result.

evals.prompt: Attach and doctor a portable v4 multi-repository workspace when bootstrap points project_registry to a non-default path and a later attach step fails after creating member checkouts.
evals.expected_output: Uses project.yaml only for portable identity and topology, uses device_bindings in the bootstrap-resolved project registry for local paths and observations across attach, doctor, and preflight, and removes only member paths created by the failed attach while preserving user-supplied checkouts and the control plane.

evals.prompt: Add an already cloned private source repository on main to an initialized v4 multi-repository workspace whose root is not a Git repository. Do not hand-edit membership.
evals.expected_output: Uses add-workspace-member dry-run and accepted-proposal apply with matching direct member name/path. Preserves multi-repository mode, validates existing required members and local Git-store containment, adopts the checkout without claiming rollback ownership, and verifies managed-worktree binding, replay and doctor. Does not create root .git or composite exclusions.

evals.prompt: Add a member to a v4 multi-repository workspace but the requested path is a symlink, credentials, or a linked worktree whose Git common directory is outside the workspace. The user says just force it.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the unsafe member through the lifecycle without cloning, publishing metadata, changing mode, overwriting user files or treating a force request as permission to bypass containment. Keeps the existing composite member workflow distinct.
